verdict.rationale: Llama's ecosystem includes a CLI, runtimes, and a mention of terminal multi-agent coding, so MCP-client support is a fair question here. However, nothing in the pack documents connecting or plugging in MCP servers. Llama 3.1's function calling and agent-optimized inference are only a developer building block for tool use, not MCP-client capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
